purpose: Rebuild registry projections with caught-error rollback and explicit persistent recovery.
state_changes: apply may replace only drifting derived files and transaction material
recover may restore only targets bound by a valid transaction journal

errors.condition: authority, contract, registry, archive, symlink, or recovery preflight is invalid
apply failed and every target was verified at its invocation-time bytes
rollback, journal update, or required cleanup could not establish a clean invocation-time state

constraints: candidate manifest is never recovery authority
downstream_consumers: projects that copy the portable sample

implementation_slices.outcome: Preflight and one-pass no-op-aware multi-surface apply behavior.
Durable backup, rollback, truthful recovery_required diagnostics, and explicit recover.
Complete fault matrix and compatibility regression evidence.
Independent final-candidate verdict and Dashboard closeout.
